title: Sr Plant Manager
text:
**Sr Plant Manager**

York, PA

**Come Join Us!**

From apartments in New York to hospitals and stadiums in Dallas, libraries at prestigious universities to creating modern retail experiences, our teams contribute architectural glass and building products to projects that shape the way people live, work, heal, learn, and play. At OBE, the work of our employees truly matters. With over 6,500 employees, we operate more than 80 manufacturing and distribution facilities in five countries. You can see some of our favorite projects
here
.

Start your journey with OBE and help us build the future.

**What You’ll Get to Do**

Graham Architectural Products specializes in solving the industry's toughest challenges through beautiful, functional & energy-efficient window and door systems including casement, hung, sliding & projected windows, entrance doors, security & vandal screens, and window wall systems for demanding commercial & institutional projects.

We're looking for a
**Senior Plant Manager**
to own day-to-day operations across two York-area facilities: a large, highly profitable manufacturing plant and a smaller warehousing facility that also runs CNC & packaging operations. This is a highly custom, engineer-to-order manufacturing environment, different from standard build-to-inventory work, where production runs in close coordination with estimating, project management & customer-facing teams to meet demanding, lead-time-driven commitments.

This role is ideal for a collaborative, results-oriented operator who has already run a plant of significant scale & complexity, leads with lived lean/continuous-improvement discipline rather than certifications alone, and understands that in a custom manufacturing business, every operational decision has a direct & visible impact on the customer.

Key Responsibilities:

* Own full plant operations across both York facilities manufacturing, warehousing, CNC & packaging driving safety, quality, OpEx, production & efficiency
* Lead, mentor & develop managers and supervisors across multiple disciplines, building a winning culture & strong succession bench
* Partner closely with estimating, project management & customer service to ensure production schedules & product standards meet demanding lead times
* Champion daily, hands-on lean/continuous-improvement execution on the shop floor spotting waste & opportunity in real time
* Lead plant optimization & automation transformation initiatives, championing new technology, robotics & control systems to modernize operations
* Drive continuous improvement projects that reduce downtime, improve throughput & increase Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
* Create, recommend & manage capital projects, including automation & equipment upgrades, from business case through implementation
* Partner with engineering & IT to integrate MES/ERP systems, data analytics & real-time reporting into daily plant decision-making
* Build strong working relationships with sales & customers, applying emotional intelligence & clear communication to manage expectations in a custom, deadline-driven environment
* Guide teams through technology-driven & organizational change as the plant modernizes & the business continues to grow

**What We Are Looking For**

We know great candidates come from all kinds of backgrounds. If you don’t check every box below, we’d still love to hear from you.

* Must have a Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of managerial experience in a manufacturing environment, including experience managing more than one discipline or department
* Prior experience as a Plant Manager or in a similar plant leadership role at a facility of comparable size & complexity
* Hands-on management experience with budgeting, quality assurance & equipment troubleshooting
* Demonstrated, day-to-day lean manufacturing execution, comfortable identifying & driving improvement on the shop floor without relying on formal belt certification alone (Green Belt/Black Belt or TPS experience a plus)
* Proven track record leading plant optimization & automation/digital transformation projects, including robotics, PLC/controls & MES/ERP integration
* Experience managing capital projects for automation & equipment upgrades, from business case through implementation
* Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills; familiarity with OEE, KPI dashboards & performance analytics
* Experience in a custom, engineer-to-order, or made-to-order manufacturing environment strongly preferred
* Strong customer-relationship orientation & cross-functional communication skills; comfortable partnering with sales, estimating & project management on lead-time-sensitive commitments

**What OBE Offers You**

* Benefits that benefit you – industry competitive
 benefits
 at the lowest cost to the employee
* Work-life balance – PTO and holidays, including floating holidays you can choose
* Compensation that rewards your hard work – A pay-for-performance culture with potential for annual raises and bonuses
* Training – We will equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed

OBE Privacy Policy

OBE will not discharge or discriminate against employees or applicants for discussing, disclosing, or inquiring about their own or others' pay.
